title: Installation Package — Docker Compose, One-Line Installer, and Windows/WSL Setup
goal: Make AegisPT installable in under 5 minutes on any target environment with a single command — no manual dependency management required.
scope: Implement three installation paths: (1) DOCKER COMPOSE: create docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.override.yml.example at the repo root. Services: aegispt-api (FastAPI + workers), aegispt-db (PostgreSQL), aegispt-redis (Redis), aegispt-tools (Kali-based container with nmap/nuclei/zap/nxc/bloodhound/responder/metasploit pre-installed). A .env.example documents all required variables. docker-compose up brings the full stack up in one command. Healthcheck endpoints confirm readiness. (2) ONE-LINE KALI INSTALLER: improve the existing install_aegispt_host.sh into a polished interactive installer that: detects Kali version, installs missing dependencies (python3, venv, nmap, nuclei, nxc, bloodhound-python, responder, metasploit, hashcat, impacket), configures the systemd service, generates a .env with secure defaults, prints a clear 'AegisPT ready at http://localhost:8000' message. Curl-installable: curl -fsSL https://install.aegispt.io/install.sh | bash (URL placeholder, not live). (3) WINDOWS/WSL SETUP GUIDE: docs/install/windows-wsl.md with step-by-step instructions for WSL2 + the existing scripts. (4) A docs/install/README.md index that links all three paths with a decision guide ('Which install method is right for you?').
generation_reason: There is no clean installation story. The existing scripts work but require expertise. A Docker Compose setup and a polished one-line installer are table stakes for any product targeting security teams. New evaluators need to go from zero to running scan in under 5 minutes.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Installation tooling and documentation only. No product code changes. Docker Compose uses official base images only. No live external URLs — all placeholder URLs clearly marked as such.

success_criteria: docker-compose up starts all services and passes health checks.
One-line Kali installer runs non-interactively and produces a working AegisPT instance.
docs/install/README.md explains all three paths with a decision guide.
Windows/WSL setup guide is accurate and complete.
Existing Kali acceptance tests pass against the Docker Compose stack.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

before_promotion: First-run onboarding (backlog-80) is completed and logged.
